intro.text: A massive tree found only on Patji, in the Pantheon.

description.text: Its large drooping fronds each end in a blossom as long as two hands, and after flowering the tree drops its fruit to the ground.

When its flowers bloom they mimic the mind of a hurt, frightened animal. Mind-sensing predators such as tuskrun gather expecting easy prey and kill each other instead, their bodies feeding the soil beneath the tree. A trapper can usually steer clear, but one who stumbles on a freshly bloomed tree can be caught off guard.
A grove of about a dozen surrounds Patji's Eye, which all young Aviar visit. The birds eat the fallen fruit, and with it a parasite inside that gives them their talents.

items.text: First of the Sky, a trapper, walked into a tuskrun pack drawn by a tree in fresh bloom and was killed.

Hiding from nightmaws near Patji's Eye, Vathi and Dusk fastened a blossom to one of Vathi's spear-gun spears and fired it off; drawn by the blossom's thoughts, the nightmaws followed it and the pair got away.
